hero.title: Elevating Vietnamese ingredients for global food & beverage supply chains
hero.subtitle: Whitehorse Foodtech connects sourcing, R&D and product development, quality management, and the right manufacturing capacity to build ingredient solutions that are consistent, adaptable and ready for international markets.

origin.title: Our story
paragraphs: Vietnam is home to a rich, diverse range of agricultural raw materials. But turning a local ingredient into a product that meets the standards of international food and beverage brands takes more than a good source of supply.

The product has to be developed for the right application, controlled against clear specifications, produced consistently, and backed by documentation that matches the requirements of each destination market.

Whitehorse Foodtech exists to connect those pieces into a single, coordinated process. We bring together sourcing, R&D capability, quality management, the right manufacturing partners and export operations to turn the potential of Vietnamese ingredients into solutions that can be commercialized at international scale.

Rather than starting from a fixed product, we start from what the customer actually needs: what application the product serves, what standards it has to meet, how it should be packaged, and what's required to enter the target market.

valueCreation.title: How we create value
valueCreation.subtitle: A good ingredient solution has to balance four things: the right source, a product built for its application, consistent quality, and the ability to commercialize it efficiently.

coffee.name: Coffee Ingredients
coffee.description: From Vietnam's renowned coffee regions, we supply carefully selected coffee ingredients for global food and beverage applications — from green and roasted beans to soluble powders, extracts and cold brew concentrates, available in bulk or private-label single-serve formats.
specs: Robusta: Screen 16/18, moisture 12.5% max, black & broken 3–5% max
Arabica: Screen 15+, moisture 12% max, fully washed or natural process

Processed formats: soluble coffee powder (Arabica & Robusta blend), coffee extract and concentrated coffee extract in dropper-bottle format, unsweetened cold brew concentrate — custom concentration on request
Packaging: 60kg jute bags with GrainPro liner (green beans); jars, dropper bottles, drums or bag-in-box for powder/extract/cold brew; single-serve sachets and retail boxes for private-label formats
Custom roasting, formulation and private-label packaging available

coconut.name: Coconut Ingredients
coconut.tagline: Milk, cream, water, powder, oil & MCT
coconut.description: Premium Vietnamese coconut transformed into versatile food ingredients — including coconut milk and cream, powders, water concentrates, virgin coconut oil and functional lipid solutions for international food and beverage brands, supplied in bulk or private-label retail packaging.
specs: Liquid formats: coconut milk (carton) and coconut cream (jar) at standard or custom fat content, UHT/aseptic packaging on request
Powder formats: coconut milk powder and coconut cream powder (plant-based, gluten-free, no added sugar), NFC coconut water, coconut water concentrate and coconut water powder
Oils & functional lipids: cold-pressed virgin coconut oil, unflavored MCT oil and MCT powder
Packaging: cartons, jars, stand-up pouches, aseptic bags, drums or bulk — format and packaging confirmed per order
OEM and private-label formulation available across all formats

birdsNest.name: Bird's Nest Ingredients
birdsNest.description: Premium Vietnamese edible bird's nest developed into high-value functional ingredients, including selected nest, concentrates, extracts, powders and customized formulations for nutrition and premium food applications, from bulk ingredients to retail-ready private-label formats.
specs: Formats: selected raw and cleaned bird's nest, concentrate, pure extract and powder — bottled ready-to-drink formats available
Custom formulation: sugar level, added ingredients (rock sugar, ginseng and other variants) and packaging configured to buyer requirements
Packaging: retail glass bottles (typically 70ml multi-packs) for RTD formats; jars or vacuum packs for selected/dried nest; premium gift box sets available — private-label packaging available
Shelf life and cold-chain requirements vary by format — confirmed with our export team per order

fruit.name: Fruit Ingredients
fruit.description: Vietnam's tropical fruits transformed into stable, high-quality ingredients through advanced processing — preserving natural color, aroma and nutritional value for food, beverage and nutrition applications, available as powders, pieces, concentrates and extracts.
specs: Freeze-dried powders: passion fruit, mango, dragon fruit, durian, soursop, pineapple, banana, orange and other fruits on request — moisture 3–5% max, 80–100 mesh standard
Freeze-dried pieces: slices, cubes and crumbles for bakery, cereal and snack applications
Fruit concentrates: puree and juice concentrate for beverage and flavor applications
Extracts: natural fruit extract and fruit flavor base in dropper-bottle format for precise dosing
Packaging: aluminum foil bags with desiccant (1kg–25kg) or bulk drums for powders/pieces; glass bottles for concentrates and extracts — custom particle size and packaging on request

nutsSpicesBotanicals.name: Nuts, Spices & Botanicals
nutsSpicesBotanicals.tagline: Cashew, pepper, cinnamon, star anise & botanicals
nutsSpicesBotanicals.description: Selected Vietnamese nuts, spices and botanicals sourced for international food manufacturers and ingredient partners, with export-grade specifications, quality control and full documentation.
specs: Nuts: cashew (WW240/WW320/SW240 grades, vacuum-packed 22.68kg tins) and macadamia, in-shell or kernel

Spices: black pepper (500–570 g/l density, moisture 13% max) and white pepper, cinnamon and star anise (whole, broken or ground, graded by oil content and moisture), chili — steam-sterilized on request
Botanicals: ginger, turmeric, lemongrass, pandan and other selected Vietnamese botanicals available fresh, dried or powdered on request
Packaging: retail jars and packs for private-label lines; bulk vacuum-packed tins, bags or drums for wholesale — format confirmed per order

hero.title: Certifications & standards
hero.subtitle: We partner exclusively with manufacturing facilities that meet international food safety and export compliance standards — so every shipment is backed by the certifications your market requires.

standards.title: What we require from every manufacturing partner
standards.subtitle: Before we work with a facility, it has to meet baseline international food-safety and export-compliance standards — these are the ones we screen for.

items.name: ISO 22000
items.description: Manufacturing partners are selected for a certified food safety management system — ISO 22000 or an equivalent recognized standard.

items.name: HACCP
items.description: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points protocols are a baseline requirement across every facility in our partner network.

items.name: Organic Certification
items.description: For product lines requiring organic-certified raw material, we source only through partners holding valid USDA Organic, EU Organic or an equivalent certification.

items.name: FDA Registration
items.description: For US-bound shipments, we work exclusively with FDA-registered facilities to meet FSVP and US import requirements.

sustainability.title: Built on traceable, responsible sourcing
sustainability.subtitle: Quality and sustainability aren't separate goals for us — a supply chain we can trace back to the grower is also the one most likely to be consistent, season after season.

pillars.title: Traceable sourcing
pillars.description: Every lot is tracked back to its growing region and processing facility, so quality issues can be diagnosed at the source rather than guessed at downstream.

pillars.title: Grower & cooperative partnerships
pillars.description: Long-term relationships with the cooperatives and growers we buy from, built on fair, transparent pricing rather than one-off spot purchases.

pillars.title: Environmental stewardship
pillars.description: We prioritize manufacturing partners who invest in resource-efficient processing, reduced packaging waste, and responsible farming practices across their sourcing regions.

pillars.title: Quality & food safety
pillars.description: Lot-level testing and documented specifications before shipment, so what's approved is what arrives — see our certifications above and process page for detail.

hero.title: From growing region to your container

steps.title: 1. Sourcing
steps.description: We work directly with growing cooperatives and processing partners across Vietnam's key producing regions, building long-term relationships rather than one-off purchases.

steps.title: 2. Processing & Grading
steps.description: Raw material is cleaned, sorted and graded against agreed specifications — screen size, moisture, defect count and other buyer-specific criteria.

steps.title: 3. Quality Control
steps.description: Every lot is sampled and tested before approval. Lab reports and physical samples are shared with the buyer prior to shipment, and third-party inspection can be arranged.

steps.title: 4. Packing
steps.description: Products are packed to buyer specification — standard export packaging or custom private-label packaging — with moisture and pest control appropriate to each product line.

steps.title: 5. Export Documentation
steps.description: Certificate of Origin, phytosanitary certificate, fumigation certificate and commercial documents are prepared and verified ahead of container loading.

steps.title: 6. Shipping & Delivery
steps.description: We coordinate container loading and shipping schedules to the agreed Incoterms, keeping buyers updated from port of loading to port of destination.
